dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of State officials, regional bureau staff, and diplomatic personnel operating in designated international regions.
dimensions.evidence: There shall be in the Department an Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Restructures regional diplomacy oversight and creates temporary units with monitoring and grant functions to counter foreign influence.
dimensions.evidence: establish and maintain a Countering the PRC Influence Fund Unit

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes necessary appropriations for fiscal years 2026 and 2027 and oversees administration of specific influence funds.
dimensions.evidence: receive the funds necessary to fulfill the Under Secretary's responsibilities for fiscal years 2026 and 2027

dimensions.assessment: Establishes multiple new high-level diplomatic offices, congressional notification mandates for altering regional jurisdictions, and a time-limited program unit.
dimensions.evidence: There shall be in the Department an Ambassador-at-Large for the Arctic

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent organizational offices alongside a specific 2-year sunset provision for the influence fund unit.
dimensions.evidence: A CPIF Unit established under this section shall terminate 2 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific monetary figures for authorized funding levels
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes the Under Secretary for Political Affairs, creates new Ambassador-at-Large positions for the Arctic and Indian Ocean Region, sets up assistant secretary positions, and provides for a Countering PRC Influence Fund Unit.
